name: atlas
description: Route to the smallest relevant project knowledge set, record durable findings, and bootstrap Atlas plus Trellis.

interface.shortDescription: Incremental project knowledge routing for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Atlas indexes maintained knowledge incrementally, injects only relevant paths and sections, and keeps Trellis task artifacts below canonical sources.
capabilities: Trellis and Atlas bootstrap from a conversation
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $atlas to route to the smallest relevant canonical knowledge set before work and reconcile durable findings afterward.
